Package io.jans.fido2.model.trust

Class MdsHealth

java.lang.Object
io.jans.fido2.model.trust.MdsHealth
public class MdsHealth extends Object
Health of the FIDO Metadata Service data used for attestation validation. A stale or failed MDS load is a common cause of a previously valid authenticator suddenly being rejected, and today that is visible only by grepping the server log.

Date and time fields are pre-formatted strings on purpose: the FIDO2 DataMapperService uses a plain ObjectMapper with no JSR-310 module registered, so java.time values must not be handed to it directly.
